mapper.select: SELECT ontology_space_id AS ontologySpaceId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ontology_link_group WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY ontology_space_id

SELECT t.ontology_unique_identifier AS ontologyUniqueIdentifier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT ontology_unique_identifier_from AS ontology_unique_identifier, id FROM ontology_link_group WHERE status = #{status} AND ontology_space_id = #{spaceId} AND ontology_unique_identifier_from IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT ontology_unique_identifier_to AS ontology_unique_identifier, id FROM ontology_link_group WHERE status = #{status} AND ontology_space_id = #{spaceId} AND ontology_unique_identifier_to IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY t.ontology_unique_identifier
